summary: The root لقف (lqf) means to seize or take something quickly, especially if it's thrown or said to you. It implies a swift and immediate grasp.
lane: 1 لَقِفَهُ ذ He seized it, or took it quickly; (S, M, K;) namely, a thing thrown to him with the hand, or said to him. (M, TA.) See also last sentence of 1 in art. حنك .
